baseline_evidence_release.role: Archived baseline evidence; not the final competition-paper release.

existing_synthetic_evaluation_policy.rule: The evaluated 80-site split may not select, tune, or compare any new model, gate, threshold, taxonomy rule, or selective-decision mechanism.
existing_synthetic_evaluation_policy.allowed_use: One predeclared retrospective diagnostic of fixed conditional-bootstrap and calibration-only split-conformal interval coverage; no parameter may change after this evaluation.

transition_taxonomy.human_review_requirement: Every row must be independently reviewed by students and the supervising teacher before any human-verified or causal wording.

observational_stratification.estimand: Descriptive differences in residual-diagnostic distributions by frozen Method Code transition class.
observational_stratification.not_an_estimand: Confirmed physical instrument replacement or causal measurement bias.
observational_stratification.small_group_policy: Groups with fewer than 20 complete comparisons are descriptive only.
observational_stratification.multiple_testing: Use prespecified Mann-Whitney or permutation comparisons, bootstrap median-difference intervals, and Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment.

selective_decision_extension.new_model_policy: Any new learned gate or model must use only a newly constructed blind stable-synthetic test set with fully disjoint target-plus-donor input footprints.
selective_decision_extension.forbidden_reuse: No newly evaluated model may use the existing 66 calibration or 80 evaluated target sites or their input footprints.

reporting_boundaries: Method Code remains a metadata anchor, not a confirmed instrument change.
Real events have no physical-bias ground truth.
Legacy v0.2 results remain reproducible historical evidence and may not be silently replaced.
